description: Aboard a moving bus (regression 2026-10-27, Every kit): the cabin is lit by its lamps and by what comes in through its glass, not through its body (its own tail light lit the walls salmon), and the in-world labels show only through its windows, never over its walls and roof (Interior.hides). By day ahead, dusk and night behind (the tail light), on the plains alone and in the Every kit; captured, a sheet.

steps.expr: (() => { const s = entities.sites.find(s => s.world.app?.world?.buses?.length), a = s.world.app, b = a.world.buses.find(b => Math.abs(b.v) > 3) || a.world.buses[0], wk = a.walker, B = entities.engine.kits.transit.BUS; if (entities.shared) entities.setWorldView(entities.siteFrame(s).toWorld({ pos: b.toWorld([0, 3, 0]), fwd: [1, 0, 0], up: [0, 1, 0], fov: 1 })); wk.place(a, b.pose.x, b.pose.z); Object.assign(wk, { bus: b, seat: null, feet: [-1.0, B.floor, 0], busYaw: b.yaw }); wk.eye(a); return b.label; })()
steps.note: into the plains, by a moving bus

steps.expr: (() => { const s = entities.sites.find(s => s.world.app?.world?.buses?.length), a = s.world.app, b = a.world.buses.find(b => Math.abs(b.v) > 3) || a.world.buses[0], wk = a.walker, B = entities.engine.kits.transit.BUS; if (entities.shared) entities.setWorldView(entities.siteFrame(s).toWorld({ pos: b.toWorld([0, 3, 0]), fwd: [1, 0, 0], up: [0, 1, 0], fov: 1 })); wk.place(a, b.pose.x, b.pose.z); Object.assign(wk, { bus: b, seat: null, feet: [-1.0, B.floor, 0], busYaw: b.yaw }); wk.eye(a); return b.label; })()

steps.note: day (the sun where the eye looks), ahead
steps.expr: (() => { const s = entities.sites.find(s => s.world.app?.world?.buses?.length), a = s.world.app; entities.starSite = null; a.camera.yaw = a.walker.bus.yaw + 0; a.camera.pitch = -0.1; const f = a.camera.basis().fwd, h = Math.hypot(f[0], f[2]); s.world.set("sunDir", [f[0] / h * 0.58, 0.6, f[2] / h * 0.58]); return a.inBus; })()

steps.note: dusk (the sun where the eye looks), behind
steps.expr: (() => { const s = entities.sites.find(s => s.world.app?.world?.buses?.length), a = s.world.app; entities.starSite = null; a.camera.yaw = a.walker.bus.yaw + Math.PI; a.camera.pitch = -0.1; const f = a.camera.basis().fwd, h = Math.hypot(f[0], f[2]); s.world.set("sunDir", [f[0] / h * 1.00, 0.04, f[2] / h * 1.00]); return a.inBus; })()

steps.note: dusk (the sun behind the eye, through the windscreen), behind (its light on the seats facing it is real: no salmon check)
steps.expr: (() => { const s = entities.sites.find(s => s.world.app?.world?.buses?.length), a = s.world.app; entities.starSite = null; a.camera.yaw = a.walker.bus.yaw + Math.PI; a.camera.pitch = -0.1; const f = a.camera.basis().fwd, h = Math.hypot(f[0], f[2]); s.world.set("sunDir", [-f[0] / h * 0.99, 0.03, -f[2] / h * 0.99]); return a.inBus; })()

steps.note: night (the sun where the eye looks), behind: the tail light
steps.expr: (() => { const s = entities.sites.find(s => s.world.app?.world?.buses?.length), a = s.world.app; entities.starSite = null; a.camera.yaw = a.walker.bus.yaw + Math.PI; a.camera.pitch = -0.1; const f = a.camera.basis().fwd, h = Math.hypot(f[0], f[2]); s.world.set("sunDir", [f[0] / h * 0.95, -0.3, f[2] / h * 0.95]); return a.inBus; })()

steps.note: night (the sun where the eye looks), the doors side
steps.expr: (() => { const s = entities.sites.find(s => s.world.app?.world?.buses?.length), a = s.world.app; entities.starSite = null; a.camera.yaw = a.walker.bus.yaw + Math.PI / 2; a.camera.pitch = -0.1; const f = a.camera.basis().fwd, h = Math.hypot(f[0], f[2]); s.world.set("sunDir", [f[0] / h * 0.95, -0.3, f[2] / h * 0.95]); return a.inBus; })()
